title: Claim another email domain for your school

steps.say: Your own domain was claimed when you signed up. This field is for the others — a second site, a federation, a domain the office still uses.
Type only the part after the @, such as example.sch.uk, then tap **Add domain**. Anyone arriving on your invite links from that domain is in with one tap.
Public providers such as gmail.com cannot be claimed, because they do not identify a school. For a colleague on one of those, add their address by itself in the field below.
steps.terminal: That is a claimed domain — one rule, no list of names to keep. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
